parser.description: HoYoLAB / MiYoUShe Daily Automation Assistant (zero-template setup & CN terminal QR login)
parser.epilog:
Examples:
  hoyo-assistant                         Run all enabled accounts (auto-inits config if missing; 10s QR fallback on TTY)
  hoyo-assistant list                    List configured accounts overview (redacted credentials & enabled tasks)
  hoyo-assistant login                   Scan MiYoUShe QR code to add a CN account or overwrite same UID
  hoyo-assistant login -a CN-2 --scope cloud
                                         Refresh only the Cloud Genshin token for account CN-2
  hoyo-assistant -a CN-1 OS-1            Run only specified accounts
  hoyo-assistant check --effective       Validate config and print redacted runtime config
  hoyo-assistant format --no-backup      Prune redundant cookies and format config.yaml
  hoyo-assistant server                  Start the interactive scheduled server console

Notes:
  First-run execution automatically creates a minimal config.yaml when none exists.
  Scanning a QR code for an existing UID overwrites its credentials in place without duplicates.
parser.config: Path to config file (default: config.yaml next to executable or in cwd)
parser.account: Run only specified accounts (match by name, region#index, or 1-based index)
parser.no_qr: Disable automatic 10s terminal QR prompts during task execution
parser.no_qr_run_only: --no-qr can only be used with the default run mode
parser.account_invalid_subcommand: --account cannot be used with the `{cmd}` subcommand
parser.debug: Enable debug logging (sets log level to DEBUG)
parser.log_level: Set logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR)
parser.no_log: Disable both console and file logging
parser.login: Interactive terminal QR login for CN accounts (MiYoUShe cookie & Cloud Genshin token)
parser.login_account: Target CN account name/label/index to overwrite (omit to match by UID or add new)
parser.login_name: Display name for the created or updated CN account
parser.login_scope: Credential scope: all=BBS+Cloud Genshin (default), bbs=cookie only, cloud=Cloud Genshin only
parser.server: Start the interactive scheduled server console
parser.server_daemon: Run scheduler in non-interactive daemon mode (for Docker/systemd)
parser.check_effective: Print effective runtime config with secrets redacted
parser.format: Prune redundant cookies and format config file
parser.format_no_backup: Don't create a .bak backup before formatting
parser.list: List configured accounts overview (credential status and tasks, secrets redacted)
